data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 contradicts SRC_004 because they share the mechanism of lineage-local basin descent but reach opposite conclusions about its effect: SRC_005 claims efficiency is a precondition for cross-cutting discovery, while SRC_004 claims that same efficiency is the artifact of suppression. The contradiction is REFUTED IF the efficiency gains of ownership allocation are empirically separable from suppression—i.e., if remaining within a single basin can be shown to accelerate saddle-crossing rather than prevent it.
